description_full: Alexander's, Inc. is a real estate investment trust (REIT) engaged in leasing, managing, developing and redeveloping properties. Alexander's activities are conducted through its manager, Vornado Realty Trust. Alexander's has four properties in the greater New York City metropolitan area consisting of: 731 Lexington Avenue office and retail (including Bloomberg, L.P.'s world headquarters), the Rego Center complex in Rego Park, Queens, including the Rego Park II retail property and The Alexander apartment tower, and a retail property located in Flushing, NY. Alexander's, Inc. was incorporated in 1928 and is based in Paramus, United States.

financial_summary: Alexander's, Inc. is a small-cap real estate business with a $1.3B market cap on $213M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +1% over the past three years and +0% annually across the full decade, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
Returns on capital run at 134% against a 8% cost of capital — a 126-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 2.3× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 7.2% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 58% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
